description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single ranged jump attacks (0.90 each) capped at 19999, causes [Imperil Water 20% (25s)], grants [Attach Water with Stacking], [Damage Cap +10000], [Dual Awoken Water Mode I (Kimahri)] and [Water Resonance +5% Boost] to the user

description.name: Dual Awoken Water Mode I (Kimahri)
description.text: Water abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Water abilities trigger 2 additional times, cast speed x1.50/2.00/x2.50/x3.00 and critical chance =25%/50%/75%/100% for equipped Water abilities after casting 1/2/3/4+ Water abilities

description.name: Dual Shift
description.text: Grants [Instant ATB 1] and [Dual Awoken Water Mode II (Kimahri)], removes [Dual Awoken Water Mode I (Kimahri)]

description.name: Instant ATB 1
description.text: Increase ATB charge speed by x9999999

description.name: Dual Awoken Water Mode II (Kimahri)
description.text: Water abilities deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Water abilities trigger 1 additional time, instant cast speed for Water abilities, grants [Damage Cap +10000 3] to all other allies who have any Attach Water after using a Water ability (only triggers one time)

description.name: Attach Water with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Water Level by 1 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Water 3
